**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Recognize explicit other-money nouns during attribution**

When the source directly states an `other_money` receipt using the nouns required by the extraction contract, such as `王甲收到经济补偿金4000元`, `王甲收到赔偿金4000元`, or `甲公司收到材料款4000元`, this finite role grammar rejects the relationship and runtime ingestion adds `source_relation_unresolved`. The same layout passes when the noun is merely `补偿`, so extend the bounded role vocabulary to the supported compensation, bonus, fee, deposit, fine, and material-payment nouns rather than forcing these explicit owner/value events into manual review.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
